instrument.name: grok-imagine
instrument.notes: image_gen and image_edit do not accept a seed. Hold subject by generating a locked anchor, then image_edit that file while asking for a single change.

jobs.prompt: Preserve the same subject, identity, pose, framing, crop, camera position, and key-light direction. Do not change wardrobe, props, or scene content. Do not restyle the picture into a period look, a movie still, or a genre.  Change only bokeh softness. Set bokeh softness to: hard, nervous out-of-focus field, busy background edges, subject plane sharp. Change only the out-of-focus field. Keep the subject plane sharp. Do not paint bokeh disks onto in-focus surfaces, do not melt the whole frame, do not glow the eyes, do not change lighting, do not change time of day, and do not restyle into a genre.
hold_constant: Change only the out-of-focus field. Keep the subject plane sharp. Do not paint bokeh disks onto in-focus surfaces, do not melt the whole frame, do not glow the eyes, do not change lighting, do not change time of day, and do not restyle into a genre.
